svg.aria-label: The tour on your own screen: the guide, the cursor from lesspull.com, sits below the Less Pull circle in the menu bar and says: Your turn: click the circle. The menu drops out of it. Below, the tour bar shows Stop 2 of 7, Less Pull, with seven stops, End tour, the speed switch Slow, Normal, Fast and the keys for one line back or on. Beside it the seven stops: The Pull, Less Pull, Apps, Websites, Peek, Sessions and nights, Your turn.
